title: OpenTiles catalogue provenance record
description: One per piece (spec §9). tools/pipeline/validate_catalogue.py enforces these rules plus the EU copyright-term check, the Wikidata death-year comparison, the edition rules and the score checks.

composer_wikidata.description: Wikidata item of the composer. Set it when the name alone is ambiguous; the term check then compares the death year with this item.

lyricist.description: Only when the score has lyrics.

lyricist_wikidata.description: Wikidata item of the lyricist, when the name alone is ambiguous.

transcriber.description: Who made this specific transcription (e.g. PDMX uploader ID).

arranger.description: Who simplified or arranged it, if anyone.

attribution.description: Required for CC BY pieces; shown on the piece page.

edition_note.description: Why this is not a copy of a protected edition (§§ 70/71 UrhG).

reviewed_by.description: GitHub handle of the human reviewer.

verified.description: Set to true only by a human reviewer after listening and checking.

reviewed_on.description: Date of the human review (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when verified is true.

song.description: Groups the levels of one song (ADR 0012). Every level is its own piece folder with its own record; they share the song slug. Requires 'variant'.

variant.description: What this level is called within its song, e.g. 'Melody', 'Two hands', 'Full'. Requires 'song'.

single_hand.description: Only for pieces written for one hand: the hand that plays. Without it the score must have notes for both hands.
